summary.what_it_does: The page is a reference sheet for Claude Code, Anthropic's coding tool. It defines key terms such as session, context window, token, CLAUDE.md, plan mode, Accept Edits mode, permissions, tools, MCP, subagents, hooks, and skills. It then tabulates built-in slash commands, for example /clear, /compact, /model, /cost, /usage, /context, /plan, /diff, /mcp, /agents, /hooks, /resume, and /login, with what each does. It also lists keyboard shortcuts such as Shift+Tab to cycle permission modes, Esc to interrupt, Esc Esc to open the rewind menu, Ctrl+R for reverse prompt search, and Ctrl+O for the verbose transcript.
notable: Official Anthropic reference covering glossary, slash commands, and keyboard shortcuts in one page
Explains CLAUDE.md, plan mode, and Accept Edits mode
Notes that shortcuts vary by terminal and IDE; press ? inside a session for your exact list
caveats: Some commands vary by platform and plan, according to the page
Shortcuts vary slightly by terminal and IDE
Custom, plugin, and MCP commands are not covered; typing / shows the full list in your setup
